features: IT'S GREAT TO BE A CAT: FELIX As Good As It Looks is a range of meals that look, smell & taste so delicious just like food you might have cooked yourself. With a variety of mouth-watering tastes and textures we are sure your mischievous rascal will love every mealtime.

100% COMPLETE & BALANCED: Formulated to meet FEDIAF standards, Felix As Good As It Looks provides all essential nutrients for adult cats, including high-quality proteins, energy-rich fats, and added vitamins & minerals for overall health.
IRRESISTABLE FLAVOURS & TEMPTING TEXURES: Features tender chunks in a savory jelly, designed to satisfy even the fussiest eaters.
CONVENIENT DAILY FEEDING: For an average 4KG adult cat: 3-4 pouches per day, split into at least two meals, plus fresh water.
SOURCE OF OMEGA-6 FATTY ACIDS: Enriched with Omega-6 fatty acids, which is essential for a glossy coat, healthy skin, and strong immune function.
